item.text:
Decision ID: data-directory
Recommendation: Resolve an OS-appropriate per-user application-data directory—for example `%APPDATA%` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support` on macOS, and `$XDG_DATA_HOME` or `~/.local/share` on Linux—then place the JSON file in an application subdirectory.
User Decision Request: Do you approve this cross-platform data-directory policy, or do you want one fixed path or a different per-user convention?
